# Product function issues | Problem | Answer! | | --- | --- | | ** Why Kuailu Videoconferencing?** | Kuailu Meeting can provide multi-end audio and video collaboration, conference transliteration and minutes, multilingual support and conference management; the actual functionality, number, deployment and network requirements are based on the version and configuration purchased. | | **How many people can be online at Kuailu videoconference?** | The product information shows the highest level of support of 300+ people online at the same time. The actual limit and availability of functionality depends on the version, deployment mode, network and capacity configuration. | | **What is the AI function of Kuailu videoconference?** | AI capabilities may include real-time writing, focused extraction, summary of meetings and editing and sharing of summaries; identification of accuracy and functionality available is influenced by language, audio quality, product version and configuration, and critical content should be manually reviewed. | | **What are the highlights of the core CRM product?** | A data cockpit, a single page summarizing the overall sales data, AA auto-screening of data anomalies and target accomplishment, supported by data access to the details, AIS-based analysis of personnel data, production of sales images, matching of staff performance strengths and weaknesses, AAI automatic generation of a daily sales work plan in conjunction with a customer trail, and rational scheduling of follow-up tasks. | | **What are the highlights of the core IM product? ** | As a unified AI collaboration portal, AI tools are available within the platform; ATF has flexible access to a variety of AI intelligents inside and outside, building dedicated AI collaboration teams; AI is linked to calendars, meetings, cloud disks to support scheduling, meeting and cloud disk synergizing; the built-in Claw engine can be used to access authorized system capabilities through natural language commands; and AI has a rights binding organizational structure with data trails, deployment flexibility, support authority management and operation trails. | | **What are the highlights of the core product of personnel management?** | AI covers the full recruitment process, from job writing, curriculum vitae screening to interviews to measure smart performance; digital archiving to achieve full-life tracking of staff; and the automatic synchronization of information through modular data such as recruitment, attendance and remuneration, to reduce manual recording errors. | | **What are the highlights of the administration core products?** | All-life controls for the registration of fixed assets, such as vehicles, with full process information traceable; centralized one-stop movement of multiple types of administrative resources, such as conference rooms, materials, seals; and clearance marks on all procurement process lines to support enterprise audit trails, with practical applicability based on product configuration and audit requirements. | | ** What are the highlights of procurement management core products?** | Appendices to the AI-aided rate to assist in the selection of candidate procurement options; procurement from line-to-file flow of complete process data to cross-line synergies between supply and demand; and multi-sectoral joint questionnaire research to systematically and objectively rate suppliers. | | ** What are the highlights of the core products of financial management?** | AI monitors budget fluctuations on a real-time basis, with abnormally early warning interventions; automatically tracks accounts receivable and payables to protect against the risk of bad debts; and the smart accounting engine makes financial data available to enable business documents to automatically generate accounts and reduce manual bookkeeping. | | **What are the highlights of Kuailu Claw core products?** | The capability of the system can be mobilized within the authorized limits through natural language directives; the deposition enterprise files and processes to build an exclusive enterprise knowledge base; the built-in multi-sector skills to support self-defined outreach; the multi-business system to break data islands; and the operation of independent safe sandboxes with operational marks and controls. | | **What are the highlights of Kuailu Cloud core products?** | Drag-in fast-track business applications; input text requirements, AI auto-generated business processes; open standard API, MCP interfaces to facilitate off-site systems; integration of enterprise isomer data and enable data asset-assisted business decisions. | | **What are the highlights of Kuailu Meeting core products?** | A narrow-banded high-resolution code allows meetings to take place in a weak web environment; AI automatically transcribes the content of meetings, generates minutes and supports multilingual identification; supports conference management, such as sign-in, participation control, etc.; and supports private/mixed cloud deployments, where data can be kept in the designated environment according to the deployment programme, depending on the configuration of the actual security capability. | | ** What are the functional modules of the KLUAI one-stop office system?** | The system covers seven core scenario solutions: AI CRM customer relationship management, IM instant messaging, personnel administration, administration, procurement management, financial closure, meetings, and support for inter-module synergies between entrepreneurs, finance, goods and business processes. | | **AAI application infrastructure** | AI applications are a two-way management capability platform for business people and IT personnel, with visual configuration capabilities for a generic scenario that meets the needs of an enterprise to run an innovative scenario, while being open and expanded. Specifically, the AI-based platform provides visualized development tools and modules, and developers can build interfaces and logic for applications by drag-and-drop components, connect processes, etc. without having to produce a large number of codes. This approach not only lowers the technological threshold and allows non-professional operators to participate in application development, but also helps to increase development efficiency and shortens the development cycle of applications. | | **What are the specific applications of AI applications built in enterprises? ** | KuailuAI applications capacity has been consolidated in finance, health care, retail and e-commerce, education, government services, manufacturing, business management, human resources, logistics transport and tourism, 10 industries, and 53 landing sites; their applicability depends on business processes, data, competencies, compliance requirements and scope of implementation. | | **Does the attachment to Kuailu have size limits?** | The maximum size, available storage and transmission of the mail attachment depends on the purchase of the version and the configuration of the system, which is based on the current product specifications. | | ** What's the AI smart office system? ** | Kuailu AI smart office system relies on AI to perform intelligent search, auto-filling, document management, data analysis, intelligent calendar, AI minutes, narrowband high-resolution meetings, etc., bottom data interoperable, one-stop enterprise smart office systems, and to support rights management and operation trails, depending on product version and configuration. | | ** Does the finance module support multi-organizations?** | Support for multi-organizational structures can also be based on different job profiles and operational privileges. | | **What functionality can be achieved by the Kuailu Cloud financial module?** | 1. General ledger management, vouchers, various types of financial statements are automatically generated;
2. Accounts receivable, cashier ' s reconciliation, balance queries;
3. Inventory of fixed assets;
4. Interbank accounting. | | ** Validation module. Are the completion values for these indicators automatically available? Like the recruitment rate?** | System module data are interoperable, and performance indicators are automatically captured across modules without manual filling. | | ** Software supports bar code / 2D scan? ** | Support for scanners, mobile camera sweeps and quick completion of warehousing, billing and inventory operations. | | ** Does the system support data analysis and reports?** | The built-in BI report engine, drag-down custom data viewer, achieves multi-dimensional data analysis such as inventory, sales, projects, etc. | | ** Does the system support custom business processes?** | The process engine is used for the free allocation of approved nodes, branch conditions, competencies, suitable procurement, contracts, claims, etc. | | ** Can MES function for manufacturing enterprises? Can we support traceability and dementia?** | MES Production Management Module, based on AI application, can be customized to allow full chain tracking, production control and custom development. | | ** How to balance needs-based configuration with system fluidity?** | Modules can be activated by role and business needs and pages, processes and privileges optimized; actual performance depends on product version, deployment resources, data volume, network and customization. | | ** Does it support multiple posts and multi-organizational positions?** | Multi-organizational, multi-post and account switching capabilities depend on product versions and organizational competencies, with specific roles, data ranges and approvals confirmed at the time of implementation. | | ** Does the process of approval completed support rejection or re-launch? ** | A completed process can be rejected, withdrawn or re-launched depending on product version, documentation status and administrator authority; changes should be recorded and conform to the enterprise approval system. | | ** Which use terminals are supported by the product?** | The product supports the use of the PC end, mobile end and H5 page; actual terminal coverage, functional differences and browser compatibility are based on the corresponding product version. | | ** Does the system support multi-currency settlements?** | The finance module can be converted based on the version and project configuration to support multi-currency accounting and exchange rates. The currency available, the source of exchange rates, the revaluation rules and the calibre of the statements are to be confirmed in accordance with applicable accounting standards and actual operations. | ## Specifications and scene confirmed | Information Item | Confirmed caliber | | --- | --- | | Kuailu Meeting Online Size | Up to 300+ people on-line; actual ceiling and available functionality depending on version, deployment, network and capacity configuration | | AI application setup | 10 major industries, 53 landing sites; not a 30+ industry template, not supported by a list of available points |
